title_zh: 让新同事先澄清不明要求

scenario.label_zh: 澄清新员工提问与执行的边界
scenario.goal_zh: 说明团队允许质疑不清楚的流程，同时区分必须遵守的安全要求，并确定求助对象

context_zh: 新入职的西蒙向团队负责人艾达询问内部工作习惯。
author: author-phase08-b

sentences.speaker: Simon
sentences.text: As someone newly appointed to the team, I'm not sure when it's acceptable to question a process.

sentences.speaker: Ada
sentences.text: Asking why is the norm here, especially if a request isn't clear.

sentences.speaker: Simon
sentences.text: I had the notion that new staff should just obey instructions until they'd been here for a while.

sentences.speaker: Ada
sentences.text: You must follow the safety rules, of course. But you shouldn't pretend to understand an unclear task.

sentences.speaker: Simon
sentences.text: My old office rarely discussed procedures. Do teams handle that differently nowadays?

sentences.speaker: Ada
sentences.text: Some do, but I can only speak for this one. We would rather answer a question than discover a preventable mistake later.

sentences.speaker: Simon
sentences.text: Then I'll bring the unclear delivery form to you before I complete it.

sentences.speaker: Ada
sentences.text: Please do. We'll check the requirement together, and I can show you who owns that process.
